notes.title: Update V1.0.2 is Live!
notes.content:
It's exciting to hear that folks seem to be really enjoying the game so far! That means a lot to me.

I've also been actively working to fine-tune and make fixes based-on player feedback, so far, so keep those bug reports coming if you find anything funky! I really appreciate that. :)

Today's update (version 1.0.2) patches a few minor bugs, includes a significant edit pass to fix reported typos, and adds an in-game version tab so you know when the last time the build was updated, and what I tinkered with.

Thanks again for all your support so far! If you enjoy the game, don't forget to leave a Steam review! I'd love to hear your thoughts on my dark, quirky horror adventure! And you can catch me in the Steam community discussions, too, if you want to connect!

Cheers!
-Nathan
